items.title: SpaceXSI for Students
items.summary: A 43-minute SpaceXSI workshop where Ria Goveas and Sangini Mehta show students how to plan a portfolio in Cursor and keep it going with Cloud Agents, then hire and chain Grok Bots—from email triage to calendar deadlines, plus a student crew for recruiting, Canvas, and errands.

items.title: How to Fix Your AI Images Without Starting Over | Kling Image 4.0
items.summary: A 24-second Kling Image 4.0 short: generate an image, select an object, and describe the edit—swap a prop or change its color while the rest of the scene stays intact.

items.title: Introducing Higgsfield MCP 2.0 for Claude
items.summary: An 85-second introduction to Higgsfield MCP 2.0 for Claude: the creative studio inside Claude and Fable 5.2, with pro-level tool integrations, multi-agent workflows, built-in quality control, and a three-day free trial of unlimited generations.

items.title: 身為矽谷工程師，最受不了每次開新對話都要重複交代背景❗️｜Kelly Tsai
items.summary: A 70-second course short for 《複製 AI 高手的工作系統》, on packing your work logic into a reusable skill pack so you don’t have to re-explain background every time you start a new AI chat.
